hypothesis_summary.core_reference: Asness-Frazzini-Pedersen 2019 RAS 'Quality Minus Junk' multi-axis composite framework + Novy-Marx 2013 JFE Gross Profitability + Piotroski 2000 JAR F-Score + Ohlson 1980 JAR Bankruptcy + Campbell-Hilscher-Szilagyi 2008 JF Distress (Q07 용 Earnings Stability Barber-Lyon)
hypothesis_summary.expected_role_reason: multi-axis quality composite은 (1) Value family와 구분, (2) Consensus family와 구분, (3) defense/low-beta family와 구분 → diversifier 역할. v3 설계는 poison pill 제거로 stress-robust 특성 추가 → Defense sleeve 보완 diversifier로 승격 가능.

academic_foundation.primary_reference: Asness, Clifford S., Andrea Frazzini, and Lasse Heje Pedersen, 2019, 'Quality Minus Junk', Review of Accounting Studies 24, 34-112.
secondary_references: Novy-Marx, Robert, 2013, 'The Other Side of Value: The Gross Profitability Premium', JFE 108, 1-28.
Piotroski, Joseph D., 2000, 'Value Investing: The Use of Historical Financial Statement Information', JAR 38, 1-41.
Ohlson, James A., 1980, 'Financial Ratios and the Probabilistic Prediction of Bankruptcy', JAR 18, 109-131.
Altman, Edward I., 1968, 'Financial Ratios, Discriminant Analysis and the Prediction of Corporate Bankruptcy', JF 23, 589-609.
Barber, Brad M. and John D. Lyon, 1997, 'Detecting long-run abnormal stock returns', JFE 43, 341-372. (Q07 Earnings Stability foundational)
Campbell, John Y., Jens Hilscher and Jan Szilagyi, 2008, 'In Search of Distress Risk', JF 63, 2899-2939. (distress premium foundational)
김재익·이준 (2020), '한국시장의 Quality-Minus-Junk 팩터', 한국재무학회지. (direct cite 미확인 경고)
academic_foundation.mechanism_academic: Asness 2019 multi-axis quality composite: 각 sub-factor의 noise는 독립이므로 equal-weight aggregation이 idiosyncratic noise cancellation을 통해 signal-to-noise 개선. v3 설계 추가: Q24 한국시장 negative stress_icir -0.695는 Altman Z 1968 원 공식이 USA 1950-60년대 corporate bond default 기반이며 KR 경제구조·재벌·금융감독 특성과 불일치. Campbell-Hilscher-Szilagyi 2008 hazard model은 Ohlson O (Q25) 형태로 유지 (distress 차원 커버).
academic_foundation.korean_specific: 한국 quality 실증 3층 교훈: (1) Q01 GPA standalone L-139 OOS 소멸, (2) Q04 Piotroski standalone L-133 실패, (3) Q24 Altman Z stress_icir -0.695 L-144 역방향. 단 Asness 2019 framework의 multi-axis composite은 single-axis 한계 극복. v3는 poison pill Q24 제거로 stress-robust 보강. Q07 Earnings Stability는 L-121 양쪽 위기 최강 (stress ICIR +0.753) — variant_2에서 대체 factor로 활용.
v3_distinction_from_v1: v3 variant_1 (PRIMARY): Q24 complete exclusion → 3-axis Q01+Q04+Q25 clean composite
v3 variant_2 (SECONDARY): Q24 → Q07 substitution → 4-axis Q01+Q04+Q07+Q25 defense uplift
